tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Who the connected ExplorersMap account belongs to, and how much of today's fair-use quota is left.

tools.name: get_stats
tools.description: A summary of this account's map: how many countries, territories, regions and places are marked, the Explorer score, and the share of the world explored. Answers "how many countries have I been to", and is the quickest way to see where the user stands before suggesting what to add next.

tools.name: get_badges
tools.description: Achievements this account has earned, newest first.

tools.name: list_visited
tools.description: Everything marked as visited, newest first. Paged: check `total` against `returned` and follow `nextOffset` to read the rest. Filter by type to keep the response small.

tools.name: add_country
tools.description: Mark a country as visited. Accepts an ISO-2 code or the country name. Idempotent.

tools.name: remove_country
tools.description: Unmark a country, undoing add_country. Accepts an ISO-2 code or the country name. Unmarking something that was never marked is not an error. This lowers the user's score, so confirm before removing anything they did not name.

tools.name: add_region
tools.description: Mark a state, province or département as visited. Accepts a region id (FR-95) or a name plus country. Idempotent.

tools.name: remove_region
tools.description: Unmark a state, province or département, undoing add_region. Accepts a region id like "FR-95", or a region name plus its country. Unmarking something that was never marked is not an error. This lowers the user's score, so confirm before removing anything they did not name.

tools.name: search_places
tools.description: Find places in the 90,000-entry database — cities, airports, monuments, museums, parks, heritage sites and more. Use this to get an id before add_place. Matching is on part of the name, so short beats formal: "Louvre" finds it, "Musee du Louvre" may not. Types overlap (the Louvre is filed under heri

tools.name: add_place
tools.description: Mark a specific place as visited — a monument, museum, airport, city, park and so on. Pass an id from search_places.

tools.name: remove_place
tools.description: Unmark a specific place such as a monument, museum, airport or city, undoing add_place. Accepts a place id from search_places or the exact place name. This lowers the user's score, so confirm before removing anything they did not name.

tools.name: list_trips
tools.description: The user's trips, newest first. Paged: check `total` against `returned` and follow `nextOffset` to read the rest.

tools.name: get_rank
tools.description: This account's position on a global leaderboard, with the value it was ranked on and how many explorers are ranked in total. Boards: overall score, renown, countries, regions or places. Use it to answer "where do I rank" or to compare progress over time.

tools.name: add_places_to_trip
tools.description: Attach places you have already marked to a trip. Pass visit ids from list_visited.

tools.name: set_trip_visibility
tools.description: Publish a trip on the user's public profile, or take it private again. Private trips are visible only to the account owner. Always ask before making a trip public, since it then shows the trip's title, dates and places to anyone.

tools.name: delete_trip
tools.description: Permanently delete a trip. The places in it stay marked on the map — only the grouping is removed. Requires the exact trip id and confirm:true.

tools.name: set_visit_dates
tools.description: Set the travel dates on something already marked as visited. Does not change score.

tools.name: create_trip
tools.description: Create a trip with a title and date range. Private by default.
